en.IDS_OM_HINT_DETAIL_MODE:
"Visible on Alt-key": shell and shield icons, detail view while Alt is held.
"Always ON": the detail view replaces the icons whenever a target is locked.
en.IDS_OM_HINT_COLOR_MODE:
Standard: green = overmatch, yellow = bow/stern only, red = no overmatch.
Colour-blind: blue = overmatch, yellow = bow/stern only, orange = no overmatch.

de.IDS_OM_HINT_DETAIL_MODE:
"Mit Alt-Taste sichtbar": Granate und Schild, Detailansicht solange Alt gedrückt ist.
"Immer AN": die Detailansicht ersetzt die Symbole, sobald ein Ziel aufgeschaltet ist.
de.IDS_OM_HINT_COLOR_MODE:
Standard: Grün = Overmatch, Gelb = nur Bug/Heck, Rot = kein Overmatch.
Farbenblind: Blau = Overmatch, Gelb = nur Bug/Heck, Orange = kein Overmatch.
